name: CountBadge
title: Components/Tags/CountBadge
description: Show a bounded count beside a tab, queue, or navigation item.
purpose: Show a bounded count beside a tab, queue, or navigation item.
usage: Use label to explain the count to assistive technology. Values above max display as an overflow count.

css.value:
1px solid
    color-mix(in srgb, var(--tag-fg) var(--badge-border-strength), var(--color-bg-surface))
